title: [Hack] Pay $7 for One Month of Everyday Extra and Get 10% off Grocery Discount Two Times @ Woolworths
body:
Deal: [Hack] Pay $7 for One Month of Everyday Extra and Get 10% off Grocery Discount Two Times @ Woolworths

[Raynes] What's the hack?
It seems like you're paying for a subscription and then using the benefits of that subscription
[Nunubuffs] You get one 10% discount a month. But if you do this method you can get 2x 10% discounts in a month is what hes saying
[MiscOzB] But actually 4x 10% off if you combine both hacks.
[Pobman] The original 'hack' being you only have to pay for every other month, so pay 6 months of the year but get discounts in all 12… but seems you can pay every month and get 2 x discounts instead.
[Salzberger] The discount is per calendar month. So you pay for 30 days in mid-late Jan (for example) but get 2 monthly discounts (Jan and Feb). Then you cancel the renewal but only pay again in mid-late March, and then you get the discount in March and again in April. And so on.
[Iggemo] If you sign up/cancelled on Jan 31, for example, could you get 3 months instead of 2 with this hack? Since there are only 28 days in Feb is one calendar month from Jan 31 rolling into March? Can you use this where other months also follow this pattern?
[bargainatoraah] Plus get insurance gives another 10% monthly (no stack)
[WazzaP] Worth noting the insurance discount is in store only - everyday extra works online.
WW tried making everyday extra an in store only discount but too many people complained and cancelled their subscription, but they still made the other discounts (insurance and mobile) in store only.
[SuHao] So you mean you can use one more time in August (in your example), right?
[ozbozb123] They're saying that, instead of paying $7 at 12 individual times to get 12 instances of 10% off, you pay $7 at 6 individual times and still get the 12 instances of 10% off.
[danoz] thanks OP, used to have a half price annual but haven't had one in a while. might do your hack every couple of months to replicate it :)
[MiscOzB] They removed the annual membership option recently anyway, just FYI.
[sqrt] So does that mean if you combine it with the online shop hack https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/922126 you could get 4x10% for $7?
[MiscOzB] Yep, I've been doing exactly this for probably over a year at this point - online shop on Tuesday (last day of catalogue) for click & collect the following Monday/Tuesday, then another in-store shop before the collection day. Repeat the following month then cancel membership.
[carrawa] BTW Coles just jacked up the deliver plus free delivery minimum to $75.00 before delivery fee is 'free'.
[OnlyHans] [Hack] 2 Months of Coles Plus Saver Benefits for The Price of 1 Month - $7 @ Coles
[GnarlyKnuckles] Does this discount work at 'BWS', which is often physically/spatially located within a Woolworths?
[clandestino] Bring back the bargains from a few years ago…. Where are saved some $$$!!
Instead of this trash.
